text: Acceptance 10: the hook header says atalk comes from `npm i -g agenttalks`, while the served skill says atalk 'is NOT a standalone download' and needs the repo checked out; an agent following the hook comment on a machine without the repo gets 'command not found' and the hook exits 0 silently (line 18), so the integration never reports why it is dead. Pick one story and make the hook emit one line when atalk is missing.
